customManagers.description: Images pinned as image:tag@sha256:digest in a Rust const, the value on the line after a renovate comment or the one after that, where rustfmt moves a long literal. The shared preset's manager captures a bare tag with no digest, so it cannot keep these current. DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE in src/deployment/registry.rs is the reason it exists: every generated Dockerfile builds FROM it. A tag with no image name before it does not match.

packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry SDK + exporters + the tracing bridge move in lockstep -- held at 0.31 until tracing-opentelemetry supports 0.32. Bumping one alone breaks the build.
tonic + prost are generated-and-linked together (build.rs codegen); never bump one without the other.
AWS SDK crates (aws-config, aws-sdk-*) share a release train and must move together.
